name: Emboss
author: Erin Carter
description: A full field of low-relief medallion bosses — concentric petal ridges shaded against one fixed oblique lamp. Each boss runs its own hash-staggered strike cycle, swelling up from flat metal with a brief glint as the die lands, holding in relief, then subsiding, so shadows deepen and drain across the field while the lamp never moves.

params.label: Strike period
params.effect: Length in seconds of one medallion's full swell-hold-subside cycle; short keeps the field restless with overlapping strikes, long lets each boss rise and settle like a slow breath.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Apparent depth at full strike — scales the heightfield gradient so shading runs from a whisper of low relief to deep crisp chiaroscuro.

params.label: Motif size
params.effect: Size of each embossed medallion in CSS pixels — a field of small studded bosses at the minimum, a few monumental reliefs at the maximum.
